headline: Happiest Minds Technologies Expands Q2 Margins on AI Strategy
summary: Happiest Minds Technologies posted stronger Q2 FY27 margins, driven by its AI-first strategy.
why: Happiest Minds Technologies is an Indian IT services and digital transformation company. Operating margins in the IT sector are a key indicator of pricing power and efficiency in scaling artificial intelligence solutions.

impacts.name: Happiest Minds Technologies
impacts.why: Stronger margins on an AI-first strategy directly reflect positively on the company's financial health and profitability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Margin expansion driven by strategic execution in high-demand AI segments signals higher profitability, boosting investor sentiment for the stock.
